title: aider-shim
intention: A build device — aider (~/dev/src/aider) behind a shim at cairn/devices/aider_shim/ — that builds tickets CC specifies, driving qwen3-coder:30b (Q4_K_M) on hex through the inference proxy, so CC is spent on charting and verdicts instead of on the typing. The shim drives aider in-process via its Python API (Coder.create), with the model client injected at the litellm seam so every call rides inference_domain — routed, ruled, metered, learned. No HTTP face: one web server, and sole-path stays import-visible. Input: a cast ticket's chart chain (survey holdings become the file list, constrain bounds + the decompose piece become the prompt, the ticket's proofs become aider's test loop). Output: enters proven-space through the UNCHANGED physics — proofs twice, tester seal, verdict artifact, clearance gate.
why: Law 1 — the resolver is spent on the novel: a well-charted ticket's typing is settled work, and burning CC on it is the defect. The safety is Laws 8 + 9: entry is proof-gated, so a weaker builder cannot lower the bar — the gates don't care whose hands typed. UU tried this and it didn't go well (Akien, verbatim: 'we did this once before, in UU. it didn't go well, but we didn't have the foundation we have now') — so this ticket asserts the CONDITIONAL: it works WITH the foundation UU lacked, and the falsifier tests exactly that.
traces_to: Law 1 (novel vs settled); Laws 8 + 9 (proof-gated entry is what makes a weaker builder safe); the parallel-inspectable-clone direction (ideas/2026-08-07-this-is-what-we-re-going-to — hex learning beside CC); Telos 1 through inference_domain's meter (every shim call is spent-vs-avoided data).

falsifier.proves_green: code-seam invariants: proved (tester netns seal beside the code, teeth a hollow build could not pass) + feeds back to origin on failure. Entry: BUILDME refuses without intent_berth, sorted_berth, and a berthed validate packet claiming this ticket. Exit: PROVED refuses without a complete passing verdict artifact, and rides the clearance gate (charter gated_by, boat_id = 'aider-shim'). WATCHME(aider_shim_offload_yield): emission gate resolves ARMED from the probe path before the crossing. Child proves first.
falsifier.proves_red: Done-tell: one cast ticket charted by CC, built end-to-end by the shimmed aider on hex through the inference proxy, passing the unchanged physics with the between-validate-berth-and-done CC tool-call count materially below CC building it directly (packet-score instrument, ruling 2026-08-14). Wrong-intent tell: across ~5 tickets, shepherding aider costs CC more calls than building directly, or Q4 output cannot pass proofs without CC rewriting it — the UU conditional falsified even WITH the foundation.
falsifier.horizon: First shimmed ticket is the first measurement; five shimmed tickets is the watch's enough. Build horizon: the shim device (charter, chain→aider translation, litellm injection, probe) after its one child proves.

decisions.text: The kick-back cause is gone. e50eb534 moved aider_shim/probes/ to probes_disabled/ only to take the device off the heartbeat while interceptor.py reached into inference_domain internals; ticket 50ad391f4e95 fixed that and is PROVED (interceptor.py:164 now imports nothing from inference_domain). The build, one commit 'd7b4019d2407: build — the probe returns to its berth': git mv cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes_disabled/offload_yield_probe.py cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes/offload_yield_probe.py (mkdir probes first) and git mv cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs_disabled/test_probe.py cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_probe.py; then in proofs/test_probe.py, inside test_the_probe_is_armed_at_the_path_the_TICKET_names, replace the stale ticket path Path.home()/'dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/aider-shim.json' with Path(ticket_path('d7b4019d2407')), adding 'from cairn.tools.chain.grammar import ticket_path' inside that tooth (tickets are now named <id>-<slug>.json). Measured 2026-10-13: with the files restored, that tooth is the proof's only red. Nothing else changes. Proof: cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_probe.py. Then PROVEME --proven-by it, hollow seal, verdict, WATCHME (the probe is armed at the ticket's berth), PROVED. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09; approved thru PROVED (Akien 2026-10-12)

Measured 2026-10-13: ticket_path(claim, root=CAIRN_ROOT, tickets_dir=None) -> str | None is defined at cairn/tools/chain/grammar.py:288, and ticket_path('d7b4019d2407') returns the live file CairnCommons/tickets/d7b4019d2407-<slug>.json. Measured the same day with the probe and proof restored: the stale-path tooth was the proof's only red, so after D1 the proof is expected fully green. The builder runs it and records the actual result whatever it is; a red is a kick-back, never a reshape. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

Measured 2026-10-13: cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs_disabled/test_probe.py line 30 binds the probe at module level ('from cairn.devices.aider_shim.probes import offload_yield_probe as probe  # noqa: E402'). This build adds the probe at probes/, so PROVEME's proof_binds_its_subject_at_call_time (cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py:647) reds that line and the hollow would read UNRAN. In the moved proof, that line becomes exactly 'probe = None  # bound in main(): this build adds the probe, so the hollow takes it away', and the first two lines of the body of the main function at line 454 become 'global probe' and a try: 'from cairn.devices.aider_shim.probes import offload_yield_probe as probe' / except ImportError: pass — so with the probe reverted each tooth fails on its own (None has no attribute) and prints red. No other line of the proof changes beyond D1's ticket path. The claimed chain for this repair was written 2026-10-13: the decompose berth that PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m skills.chart.live chain d7b4019d2407 prints, writes_to cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes/offload_yield_probe.py and cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_probe.py; the August validate and verdict stand. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09; approved thru PROVED (Akien 2026-10-12)
